policy: Every known release failure requires a permanent automated blocker before the next candidate tag.

incidents.rootCause: Legacy and normalized payment fields were both accepted, leaving inactive partial configuration ambiguous.
incidents.automaticBlocker: verify-normalized-runtime-config

incidents.rootCause: OCI index, platform manifest, Docker image ID and release digest were previously compared inconsistently.
incidents.automaticBlocker: activate-release OCI identity verification

incidents.rootCause: Deployable changes were stacked on non-main PR bases and could be omitted from the final release line.
incidents.automaticBlocker: tag commit must be reachable from origin/main

incidents.rootCause: GitHub diagnostic artifact quota failures were mixed with test and formal evidence status.
incidents.automaticBlocker: diagnostic artifacts are non-blocking; formal OSS evidence remains blocking

incidents.rootCause: Root health checks did not prove guest table QR, reservation and staff routes worked.
incidents.automaticBlocker: verify-public-app and release browser smoke

incidents.rootCause: DNS, TLS and callback host failures were first detected after deployment.
incidents.automaticBlocker: read-only DNS and TLS preflight

incidents.rootCause: Database work could begin before the exact runtime configuration and migration lineage were validated.
incidents.automaticBlocker: release state machine

incidents.rootCause: A failure after traffic switching required reliable restoration of an already loaded previous image.
incidents.automaticBlocker: automatic rollback plus previous public identity verification

incidents.rootCause: The canonical environment allowlist removed store credential and employee PIN fields, while preflight did not validate the store provisioning contract.
incidents.automaticBlocker: store-aware runtime preflight before backup or database work

incidents.rootCause: External preflight sent an IP address as the TLS SNI server name, relying on behavior deprecated by the Node.js runtime.
incidents.automaticBlocker: IP-aware TLS server-name selection

incidents.rootCause: The Alibaba Cloud PEM archive included a self-signed root certificate and the installer probed the reloaded TLS listener before it was ready.
incidents.automaticBlocker: normalized certificate-chain activation plus bounded TLS application probe

incidents.rootCause: A disposable PostgreSQL migration hook inherited the 10-second unit-test default and could fail under runner contention after all business assertions remained healthy.
incidents.automaticBlocker: bounded 30-second normalized database setup hook timeout

incidents.rootCause: Replacing the host Caddyfile inode left the running container attached to the old bind-mounted inode, so a valid host candidate was invisible to Caddy.
incidents.automaticBlocker: inode-preserving Caddyfile write plus host-to-container SHA256 visibility gate

incidents.rootCause: The release manifest froze the OCI index digest but activation incorrectly required Docker's loaded platform image ID to equal that different digest.
incidents.automaticBlocker: manifest schema 6 freezes and independently verifies OCI and platform image digests

incidents.rootCause: The deployment script assumed the application origin itself had ossutil and an ECS RAM role, although production intentionally reaches OSS through the payment-server evidence relay.
incidents.automaticBlocker: explicit evidence SSH relay with SHA and version-bound report transfer before activation

incidents.rootCause: The tag packaging step assumed the Docker archive reference blob was always an OCI index, although docker save may emit a directly tagged single-platform image manifest.
incidents.automaticBlocker: media-type dispatch accepts only a verified OCI index or direct image manifest and still binds the selected config digest to the loaded Docker image ID

incidents.rootCause: Worker-adapter evidence used GNU tar --sort, an option unavailable on the production host's verified GNU tar 1.26.
incidents.automaticBlocker: deterministic NUL-delimited path, mode and content hashing uses only production-verified find, sort -z, stat and sha256sum capabilities

incidents.rootCause: Activation generated a valid production backup on the private application host but then required that host to have ossutil and an ECS RAM role, even though only the payment-server evidence relay is authorized for OSS.
incidents.automaticBlocker: the application host prepares a release-bound read-only snapshot, the evidence host uploads and reads it back through OSS, and activation revalidates freshness, database identity, object count, size and SHA256 before any database write

incidents.rootCause: Activation expanded an optional empty Bash array while nounset mode was enabled; GNU Bash 4.2 on the production host treats that expansion as an unbound variable.
incidents.automaticBlocker: candidate Docker arguments are assembled as one non-empty array and the exact construction is exercised on the production host Bash version before release

incidents.rootCause: The backup evidence used the payment-server relay, but post-cutover deployment and completion archives still invoked OSS locally on the private application host after public readiness succeeded.
incidents.automaticBlocker: activation waits for deployment and completion reports from the external evidence host and matches every staged object by prefix, count, size and SHA256 before it can complete
